title: 第597章 再次回归傻子第596章 我要见太初古神
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：傻子的神秘身份第一卷：默认第597章再次回归傻子（..la）与此同时，七道玉珏的残影自他袖中飞出，宛如七颗初升的星辰，在虚空中各自旋绕成环，映照出冷冰寒、柳云烟、童梦妍等七人转世后的模样。
面容尚未成形，眉目犹带稚嫩，却已含笑微扬，仿佛在轮回彼岸早已知晓重逢之期，正静静地等待着他。
陈景言仰面坠入那无边光渊，身体被温暖而浩瀚的力量包裹。
就在意识即将沉入黑暗的刹那，他唇边却浮起一抹释然的笑意——丝缕般的释然笑意悄然浮现在她的唇角，仿佛卸下了积压多年的重担，又似命运终于在漫长等待后给予了一丝温柔的回应。
或许这一切真的都是冥冥之中的天意安排，他曾经无数次怀疑、挣扎、抗拒，可此刻，却不由自主地选择了相信——不是出于理性，而是源于心底最深处那无法言说的直觉与宿命感。
就在这心念微动之际，光渊的最深处骤然传来异响——七道原本各自独立、凄厉哀婉的啼哭声竟在同一瞬间交汇融合，彼此缠绕、共鸣激荡，最终凝聚成一声清越悠长、穿透云霄的凤唳，仿佛远古神鸟自沉睡中苏醒，宣告某种尘封真相的破茧而出。
紧接着，周遭的一切景象如同被无形之力击碎的琉璃，先是细微裂纹蔓延，继而轰然崩解，碎片四散飞溅却无声无息，最终尽数消融于虚空之中，不留一丝痕迹，唯余一片浩渺无垠的虚无，仿佛从未存在过。
江海市，这座滨海都市依旧车水马龙，霓虹闪烁，而陈薇薇与陈楚月这对姐妹正驱车穿行于熟悉的街道，缓缓驶向归家之路。
车内气氛略显沉闷，陈楚月紧握方向盘，目光虽注视前方路况，心思却早已飘远。
她忍不住侧过头，回头望了一眼坐在副驾上的姐姐陈薇薇，语气中夹杂着十年积攒的困惑与焦灼：“姐，景言离家整整十年了，整整三千多个日夜……他到底去了哪里？为什么每次我们追问紫霞宫的人，他们总是含糊其辞、避而不答？他们是不是知道些什么，却因为某种原因不敢明说？”
陈薇薇没有立刻回答，只是下意识地用指尖轻轻摩挲着悬挂在颈间的那枚温润玉坠。
玉质细腻如脂，在车内昏黄灯光下泛着柔和内敛的光泽，更令人惊异的是，玉坠内部竟隐隐浮现出半枚若隐若现的龙纹，仿佛活物般随着她的体温微微流转。
她轻叹一声，声音里透着无奈与茫然：“我也不知道啊……你问我，我又该去问谁呢？”
车子平稳地停在了陈家公寓楼前。
十年光阴荏苒，物是人非，唯有这栋老楼外墙攀附的凌霄花依旧年年如期盛放，繁茂藤蔓如瀑垂落，橘红色的花瓣在晚风中轻轻摇曳，几片悄然飘落，恰好沾上了陈薇薇微微扬起的睫毛，仿佛时光特意为这一刻点缀的一抹温柔注脚。
“妈妈，你们回来了！”
两个稚嫩清脆的声音同时响起。
陈薇薇的儿子和陈楚月的女儿早已在门口等候多时，一见到母亲下车，立刻欢快地奔上前，一人牵住一只手，小脸上满是依恋与喜悦。
男孩仰起圆润的小脸，乌黑的眼睛忽闪着，忽然指向不远处公寓楼拐角的阴影处，带着孩童特有的直率说道：“妈妈，那里蹲着一个傻子。”
陈薇薇心头莫名一紧，顺着孩子所指的方向望去。

只见青石台阶旁，果然蜷缩着一个衣衫褴褛、蓬头垢面的男子，身形瘦削，姿态卑微，正低头专注地摆弄着自己破旧衣角的一处线头。
尽管面容模糊、气质颓唐，但那轮廓线条却透着一股难以言喻的熟悉感，仿佛深埋记忆深处的某个身影突然浮现。
她几乎是下意识地快步走了过去。
那人依旧低着头，似乎对外界毫无察觉。
陈薇薇在他面前缓缓蹲下身子，屏住呼吸，仔细端详那张饱经风霜的脸——刹那间，瞳孔骤然收缩，心脏狂跳如鼓，脱口而出一声难以置信的惊呼：“景言？！是你吗？你怎么会在这里？！”
陈楚月闻声猛地松开女儿的小手，不顾一切地冲了过来。
那男子缓缓抬起头，眼神空洞涣散，带着一种近乎痴傻的茫然，怔怔地望着眼前两位泪眼婆娑的女子。
陈楚月再也控制不住情绪，扑上前紧紧抱住他，泪水夺眶而出，声音哽咽颤抖：“景言……真的是你！你终于回来了……”
姐妹二人紧紧拥抱着失而复得的亲人，十年的思念、担忧、绝望与期盼在此刻化作汹涌泪水，痛哭失声，仿佛要将所有积压的情绪倾泻殆尽。
站在一旁的两个孩子都已十岁，正是懵懂又敏感的年纪。
他们睁大眼睛，怔怔望着眼前这难以置信的一幕。
平日里雷厉风行、在商场上叱咤风云、被无数人称为“江海市霸道美女总裁”的母亲们，此刻竟如此失态、如此脆弱，全然不顾形象地抱头痛哭。
这一幕深深烙印在他们幼小的心灵中，成为日后回想起时既震撼又温暖的永恒画面。..la
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The Fool's Mysterious Identity Volume 1: Default Chapter 597 Returns to the Fool again (..la) At the same time, the afterimages of seven jade jewels flew out from his sleeves, like seven rising stars, each spinning in a ring in the void, reflecting the reincarnated appearance of Leng Binghan, Liu Yunyan, Tong Mengyan and other seven people.
His face has not yet formed, and his eyebrows are still childish, but he is already smiling slightly, as if he already knows the time of reunion on the other side of reincarnation and is quietly waiting for him.
Chen Jingyan fell into the boundless abyss of light on his back, and his body was wrapped in warm and vast power.
Just when his consciousness was about to sink into darkness, a relieved smile appeared on his lips - a silky relieved smile quietly appeared on the corners of her lips, as if the burden that had been accumulated for many years had been lifted, and as if fate had finally given a gentle response after a long wait.
Perhaps all of this was really an arrangement of God's will. He had doubted, struggled, and resisted countless times, but at this moment, he involuntarily chose to believe it—not out of rationality, but from the indescribable intuition and sense of destiny deep in his heart.
Just when this thought was slightly moving, a strange sound suddenly came from the deepest part of the Guangyuan - seven independent, sad and sad cries actually merged and merged at the same moment, entangled with each other, resonated and stirred, and finally condensed into a clear and long phoenix call that penetrated the clouds, as if the ancient divine bird had awakened from its slumber, announcing that some kind of dust-laden truth had emerged from its cocoon.
Immediately afterwards, all the surrounding scenes were like glass shattered by invisible force. First, tiny cracks spread, and then suddenly disintegrated. The fragments scattered in all directions but silently. Finally, they all melted into the void, leaving no trace, leaving only a vast nothingness, as if it had never existed.
Jianghai City, this coastal city is still bustling with traffic and flashing neon lights, and sisters Chen Weiwei and Chen Chuyue are driving through familiar streets, slowly heading home.
The atmosphere in the car was a bit dull. Chen Chuyue held the steering wheel tightly. Although her eyes were focused on the road ahead, her mind was already far away.
She couldn't help turning her head and glanced back at her sister Chen Weiwei who was sitting in the passenger seat. Her tone was mixed with ten years of confusion and anxiety: "Sister, Jing Yan has been away from home for ten years, more than three thousand days and nights... Where has he been? Why do people from Zixia Palace always be vague and avoid answering every time we ask? Do they know something, but for some reason they dare not say it clearly? "
Chen Weiwei did not answer immediately, but subconsciously gently rubbed the warm jade pendant hanging around her neck with her fingertips.
The jade was as delicate as fat, glowing with a soft and restrained luster under the dim light in the car. What was even more surprising was that half of a looming dragon pattern appeared faintly inside the jade pendant, which was slightly flowing with her body temperature like a living thing.
She sighed softly, with helplessness and confusion in her voice: "I don't know either... If you ask me, who should I ask?"
The car stopped smoothly in front of the Chen family apartment building.
Ten years have passed, things have changed, but the Lingxiao flower clinging to the outer wall of this old building still blooms as scheduled every year. The lush vines hang down like a waterfall, and the orange-red petals sway gently in the evening breeze. A few pieces fall quietly, just catching Chen Weiwei's slightly raised eyelashes, as if time has specially decorated this moment with a gentle footnote.
"Mom, you are back!"
Two young and clear voices sounded at the same time.
Chen Weiwei's son and Chen Chuyue's daughter had been waiting at the door for a long time. As soon as they saw their mother getting out of the car, they immediately ran forward happily and held each other's hands. Their little faces were full of attachment and joy.
The boy raised his round little face, his dark eyes flashing, and suddenly pointed to the shadow at the corner of the apartment building not far away, and said with the characteristic bluntness of a child: "Mom, there is a fool squatting there."
Chen Weiwei's heart tightened inexplicably, and she followed the child's instructionsLooking in the direction.
I saw a ragged, unkempt man curled up beside the bluestone steps. He was thin and humble, lowering his head and concentrating on playing with a thread on the corner of his shabby clothes.
Although the face is blurred and the temperament is decadent, the contours and lines convey an indescribable sense of familiarity, as if a figure buried deep in the memory has suddenly emerged.
She walked over quickly, almost subconsciously.
The man still lowered his head, seemingly unaware of the outside world.
Chen Weiwei slowly squatted down in front of him, held her breath, and carefully looked at the weather-beaten face - in an instant, her pupils suddenly shrank, her heart beat like a drum, and she blurted out an unbelievable exclamation: "Jing Yan?! Is it you? Why are you here?!"
Hearing the sound, Chen Chuyue suddenly let go of her daughter's little hand and rushed over desperately.
The man slowly raised his head, his eyes were empty and unfocused, and he stared blankly at the two women with tearful eyes in front of him with an almost foolish confusion.
Chen Chuyue could no longer control her emotions and rushed forward to hug him tightly. Tears burst into her eyes, her voice choked and trembling: "Jing Yan... it's really you! You're finally back..."
The two sisters hugged their lost relatives tightly. Ten years of longing, worry, despair and expectation turned into tears at this moment, crying bitterly, as if they wanted to pour out all the accumulated emotions.
The two children standing aside are already ten years old, an age that is both ignorant and sensitive.
They opened their eyes wide and stared at the incredible scene in front of them.
Mothers who usually act resolutely, dominate the shopping mall, and are called "the domineering beautiful presidents of Jianghai City" by countless people, are now so out of character, so fragile, crying in their arms without any regard for their image.
This scene was deeply imprinted in their young minds and became an eternal picture that was both shocking and warm when they recalled it in the future. ..la
